results.question: How does the stack work in Magic?

routing.question: How does the stack work in Magic?
routing.wants: How a card or a rule works: timing, the stack, priority, what beats what.
routing.subject: catalogue

results.answer:
I can read you a card and everything we hold about it, but we do not keep a copy of the rules, so I will not answer a timing or stack question from memory.

Gatherer carries the official rulings for a card, and the Comprehensive Rules cover the rest. A judge at your local shop will beat both.

results.question: If my creature has deathtouch and trample, how much damage do I have to assign to the blocker?

results.question: What does Rhystic Study do?

routing.question: What does Rhystic Study do?
routing.wants: What a card is, what it does, what it costs and how much it is played.
routing.subject: card

results.answer:
**Rhystic Study** {2}{U}

Enchantment.

What it says, straight off the card:

> Whenever an opponent casts a spell, you may draw a card unless that player pays {1}.

We file it under: draws cards, slows everyone down.

Commander plays it at rank 44. That is a place in a list of every card sorted by how many decks run it, so rank 1 is the most played card there is.

It is on the Commander game changer list, which matters for bracket three and below.

Legal in Commander, Legacy, Vintage, Pauper, Brawl, Historic and Oathbreaker. Not legal in Standard, Pioneer and Modern.

About $64.33, or €33.74 in euros. There are 11 printings and they do not all cost the same.

Nothing in the combo list we hold pairs it with anything. That list comes from Commander Spellbook and it is not everything anybody has ever found.

results.answer:
**Agadeem's Awakening // Agadeem, the Undercrypt**

Sorcery // Land.

What it says, straight off the card:

> Agadeem's Awakening {X}{B}{B}{B}
> Sorcery
> Return from your graveyard to the battlefield any number of target creature cards that each have a different mana value X or less.
> 
> Agadeem, the Undercrypt
> Land
> As this land enters, you may pay 3 life. If you don't, it enters tapped.
> {T}: Add {B}.

We file it under: gets things back from the graveyard.

Commander plays it at rank 958. That is a place in a list of every card sorted by how many decks run it, so rank 1 is the most played card there is.

Legal in Commander, Pioneer, Modern, Legacy, Vintage, Brawl, Historic and Oathbreaker. Not legal in Standard and Pauper.

About $27.39, or €24.62 in euros. There are 3 printings and they do not all cost the same.

It turns up in 4 combos we hold:

- with Archaeomancer, Ashnod's Altar and Dockside Extortionist: infinite artifact ETB and infinite artifact LTB, plus 11 more. Needs {B}{B}{B}.
- with Archaeomancer, Ashnod's Altar, Panharmonicon and Priest of Gix: infinite black mana and infinite colorless mana, plus 5 more. Needs {4}{B}{B}{B}.
- with Archaeomancer, Ashnod's Altar, Priest of Gix and Yarok, the Desecrated: infinite black mana and infinite colorless mana, plus 5 more. Needs {4}{B}{B}{B}.
- with Ardent Elementalist, Ashnod's Altar and Dockside Extortionist: infinite artifact ETB and infinite artifact LTB, plus 11 more. Needs {B}{B}{B}.

results.question: Is my mana base any good?

routing.question: Is my mana base any good?
routing.wants: Which lands in a deck are weak, and what to play instead.
routing.subject: deck

results.answer:
33 lands. These are the weakest slots, worst first, judged on what each one taps for against BGUW:

- Zoetic Cavern: taps for C. That is none of your colours.
- Roadside Reliquary: taps for C. That is none of your colours.
- Rogue's Passage: taps for C. That is none of your colours.
- Academy Ruins: taps for C. That is none of your colours.
- Accursed Duneyard: taps for C. That is none of your colours.
- Ruins of Oran-Rief: taps for C. That is none of your colours.
- Zhalfirin Void: taps for C. That is none of your colours.
- Blast Zone: taps for C. That is none of your colours.
- Adagia, Windswept Bastion: taps for W. That is one colour, and it enters tapped.

One thing to hold in mind. This is judged on colours only, so a land that makes no colour sits at the top of the list whatever else it does. If one of those is in there for what it does rather than what it taps for, keep it.

Straight swaps, keeping the land count where it is at 33:

- Cut Zoetic Cavern, play Command Tower. Taps for BGUW, enters untapped. $0.26.
- Cut Roadside Reliquary, play Exotic Orchard. Taps for BGUW, enters untapped. $0.19.
- Cut Rogue's Passage, play Path of Ancestry. Taps for BGUW, sometimes enters tapped. $0.22.
- Cut Academy Ruins, play Watery Grave. Taps for BU, enters untapped if you pay the life. $9.42.
- Cut Accursed Duneyard, play Breeding Pool. Taps for GU, enters untapped if you pay the life. $9.27.
- Cut Ruins of Oran-Rief, play Godless Shrine. Taps for BW, enters untapped if you pay the life. $7.99.
